aiReview.summary: Official DeepSeek API Docs news post announcing DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, API alias `deepseek-flash`, pricing/routing changes, and Hugging Face/paper links. Useful as a changelog, not a standing developer reference.

Instructs setting model to deepseek-flash; retired aliases route to V4.1-Flash.
States new pricing from 04:00 UTC Sept 10, 2026 and V4-Pro reroute from Sept 14, 2026.
HF model URL and tech report path listed under open-source deployment.
uncertainty: Actual benchmark numbers live in images, not extractable text.
Whether this news slug remains the canonical product page versus updated docs.
aiReview.tagline: Official API news on V4.1-Flash, pricing, and routing
aiReview.description: Announces DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on the API, multimodal support, KV-cache savings, price cuts, and open-weight links.

Specifies the live API model name `deepseek-flash` and temporary aliases for retired Flash models.
Documents KV-cache reductions, peak/off-peak pricing, and V4-Pro request rerouting dates.
Links Hugging Face weights and a technical report PDF.
cons: It is a news/changelog page, not API reference, SDK, or a model card.
Marketing claims about benchmarks versus V4-Pro are not independently verified here.
Time-sensitive routing and price dates will go stale as a directory listing.

aiReview.tagline: Official multimodal MoE weights with 1M-token context
aiReview.description: Official Hugging Face card for a 552B-backbone multimodal MoE model: image-text input, MIT weights, transformers, and local inference notes.
pros: Hosted under the official deepseek-ai Hugging Face org with MIT license.
Model card documents architecture (CED, CSA2), 1M context, and image-text-to-text pipeline.

Local inference needs weight conversion and large hardware; not a drop-in API SDK.
